title: SIFARI: Self-Supervised Interferometric Fitting for Astronomical Radio Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2609.35966v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Radio-interferometric images are reconstructed from sparsely sampled visibilities, and CLEAN-based imaging can struggle with spatial filtering, complex morphologies, and uncertainty quantification. Alternative methods that fit visibilities directly can address some of these limitations but often require manual choices of image priors and model hyperparameters. We present SIFARI (Self-Supervised Interferometric Fitting for Astronomical Radio Imaging), a self-supervised neural network workflow that represents sky brightness as a continuous function of position and fits measured visibilities without an external image training set or explicit spatial regularizer. An empirical rule sets the Fourier feature scale from the visibilities before training, controlling how readily the network fits fine structure. translated_title: SIFARI：用于天文射电成像的自监督干涉拟合方法
translated_abstract: 射电干涉图像是从稀疏采样的可见度数据中重建得到的，而基于CLEAN的成像方法在空间滤波、复杂形态结构以及不确定性量化方面往往存在困难。直接拟合可见度数据的替代方法可以解决其中一些局限，但通常需要手动选择图像先验和模型超参数。我们提出了SIFARI（自监督干涉拟合天文射电成像），这是一种自监督神经网络工作流程，它将天空亮度表示为位置的连续函数，并在无需外部图像训练集或显式空间正则化器的情况下拟合测量的可见度数据。在训练之前，一个经验规则可根据可见度数据设定傅里叶特征尺度，从而控制网络拟合精细结构的难易程度。通过随机权重平均-高斯采样对网络权重进行采样，可以得到近似的天空亮度不确定性估计，我们…
tldr: SIFARI提出了一种自监督神经网络方法，将天空亮度表示为位置的连续函数并直接拟合测量的可见度数据，无需外部训练集或显式正则化，同时通过SWAG技术提供天空亮度的不确定性估计。
en_tdlr: SIFARI presents a self-supervised neural network approach that represents sky brightness as a continuous function of position and directly fits measured visibilities without external training sets or explicit regularizers, while providing approximate brightness uncertainty estimates via SWAG.
